name: taking-book
description: Taking Book monorepo: shared core logic, shared React renderer, Electron desktop app, Capacitor Android app.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @taking-book/core && npm run build --workspace @taking-book/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @taking-book/core && npm run test --workspace @taking-book/renderer && npm run test --workspace @taking-book/desktop && npm run test --workspace @taking-book/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @taking-book/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @taking-book/renderer && npm run typecheck --workspace @taking-book/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace @taking-book/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @taking-book/renderer && npm run lint --workspace @taking-book/desktop && npm run lint --workspace @taking-book/mobile
